# f5xc_dns_lb_pool (Resource)

DNS Load Balancer Pool  object is used for configuring DNS Load Balancer Pool

To get more information about f5xc_dns_lb_pool, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/dns-lb-pool)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Dns Lb Pool - Full

resource "f5xc_dns_lb_pool" "example" {
  name        = "example-dns-lb-pool-v2vvqqz4"
  namespace   = "system"
  description = "DNS LB pool example"

  labels = {
    env = "example"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner = "platform"
  }

  pool_type_choice = {
    a_pool = {
      members = [
        {
          ip_endpoint = "9.9.9.9"
          name        = "member-1"
          ratio       = 10
          priority    = 5
        },
        {
          ip_endpoint = "8.8.8.8"
          name        = "member-2"
          ratio       = 20
          priority    = 10
        }
      ]
      max_answers = 2
      health_check_choice = {
        disable_health_check = true
      }
    }
  }

  load_balancing_mode = ["RATIO_MEMBER"]

  ttl_choice = {
    ttl = 180
  }
}
```

```terraform
# Example: Dns Lb Pool - Mx

resource "f5xc_dns_lb_pool" "example" {
  name      = "example-dns-lb-pool-uvol2hfz"
  namespace = "system"

  pool_type_choice = {
    aaaa_pool = {
      members = [
        {
          ip_endpoint = "2001:db8::1"
          name        = "aaaa-member"
          ratio       = 1
          priority    = 10
        }
      ]
      max_answers = 1
    }
  }

  load_balancing_mode = ["RATIO_MEMBER"]

  ttl_choice = {
    ttl = 60
  }
}
```

```terraform
# Example: Dns Lb Pool - Srv

resource "f5xc_dns_lb_pool" "example" {
  name      = "example-dns-lb-pool-cabig8e4"
  namespace = "system"

  pool_type_choice = {
    srv_pool = {
      members = [
        {
          target            = "svc.example.com"
          port              = 443
          priority          = 10
          weight            = 10
          ratio             = 1
          name              = "srv-member"
          final_translation = false
        }
      ]
      max_answers = 1
    }
  }

  load_balancing_mode = ["ROUND_ROBIN"]

  ttl_choice = {
    ttl = 30
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `load_balancing_mode` (List of String) Load Balancing Mode<br>**Allowed Values (choose one):** `['PRIORITY', 'RATIO_MEMBER', 'ROUND_ROBIN', 'STATIC_PERSIST']`
- `name` (String) name This is the name of configuration object. It has to be unique within the namespace. It can only be specified during create API and cannot be changed during replace API. The value of name has to follow DNS-1035 format.
- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''
- `pool_type_choice` (Attributes) Pool Type<br>Exactly one of `a_pool`, `aaaa_pool`, `cname_pool`, `mx_pool`, or `srv_pool` must be specified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pool_type_choice))
- `ttl_choice` (Attributes) TTL choice TTL in seconds<br>Exactly one of `ttl` or `use_rrset_ttl` must be specified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ttl_choice))

Typically generated by the server on successful creation of an object and is not allowed to change once populated. Shadowed by SystemObjectMeta's uid field.
